Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Wishes of Quiet Snowfall.
2pcs Set: Glacio +10%.
5pcs Set: Inflicting Glacio Chafe on enemies increases Glacio DMG dealt by 10% for 15s. The Resonator gains the Snowfall effect, which can be triggered once every 25s.
While Snowfall is active:
- Dealing Resonance Liberation DMG removes Snowfall and increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 25% for 6s. Dealing Resonance Liberation DMG again during the effect prolongs its duration by 4s, triggered once every 0.5s, up to 6 times each time Snowfall is removed.

Khi Tuyết Rơi đang hoạt động:
- Gây Sát Thương Resonance Liberation sẽ loại bỏ Tuyết Rơi và tăng 25% Crit. Rate cho Resonator trong 6 giây. Nếu tiếp tục gây Sát Thương Resonance Liberation trong thời gian này, hiệu ứng sẽ kéo dài thêm 4 giây, kích hoạt mỗi 0,5 giây, tối đa 6 lần mỗi khi Tuyết Rơi bị loại bỏ.
- Sử dụng Outro Skill sẽ loại bỏ Tuyết Rơi và tăng 25% Glacio DMG cho Resonator kế tiếp trong 15 giây.
Mỗi lần loại bỏ Tuyết Rơi chỉ có thể kích hoạt một trong hai hiệu ứng trên.

source_en: Startorch Academy and the Roya Tribe have joined forces to establish a foothold on the Dimmr Plains, launching a joint scientific expedition into this long-isolated realm. When Resonators besides Lucilla inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> onto the target, Lucilla consumes <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=3} of <color=Highlight>Film Roll</color> to inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=time SapTag=4} on the target. This effect can be triggered once every {5}s.

<size=40><color=Title>Zoom</color></size>
Each stack of <color=Highlight>Zoom</color> increases the Crit. DMG of the active Resonator's Echo Skill by {9}.

<size=40><color=Title>Oblivion</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color> consumes 1 <color=Highlight><te href=110902>Photo</te></color> to perform <color=Highlight>Oblivion</color>, dealing 1 instance of <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring <SapTag=A>{10}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A} of Concerto Energy:

Every <SapTag=F>{17}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F} of <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color> restored generates 1 <color=Highlight>Photo</color>.
